question_summary: Whether the Section 31 25 00 erosion control requirement for the disturbed slope area shown on Civil Detail 2/C501 is consistent with the geotechnical report's requirements for that area.
deadline_text: A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
routing_rationale: The discrepancy involves consistency between civil erosion control specifications and geotechnical requirements, so it is routed to the Civil Engineer as the design professional of record for this discipline.
